workflow.name: Qualified enquiry handoff
workflow.trigger: The agency's intake workflow marks an enquiry as qualified.
workflow.destination: A client-owned staging webhook accepts the normalized enquiry.
workflow.expectedOutcome: The client system creates one review task and returns a correlation identifier.
workflow.expectedVolume: Up to 500 events per month after pilot acceptance

exclusions: No production deployment during the fixed sprint.
No direct communication with the agency's client.
No CRM redesign or additional destination adapters.

stages.name: Contract
stages.output: Freeze the event schema, destination response and success criteria.

stages.name: Adapter
stages.output: Implement one destination adapter with bounded timeouts and no redirect following.

stages.name: Replay
stages.output: Apply stable idempotency, retry policy and terminal failure handling.

stages.name: Evidence
stages.output: Generate metadata-only attempt records and a signed delivery receipt.

stages.name: Handoff
stages.output: Deliver tests, operator runbook and rollback boundary to the agency.

eventSchema.rule: Stable unique identifier reused for every retry.
Versioned event name agreed before implementation.
UTC ISO-8601 timestamp from the originating system.
Only fields required by the destination contract.
Shared identifier across agency, workflow and delivery receipt.

acceptanceTests.name: Input contract
acceptanceTests.passCondition: Valid events are accepted and missing required fields are rejected before delivery.

acceptanceTests.name: Replay safety
acceptanceTests.passCondition: Two submissions with one event_id create no more than one downstream side effect.

acceptanceTests.name: Bounded retry
acceptanceTests.passCondition: A synthetic temporary failure produces a visible retry and a terminal disposition.

acceptanceTests.name: Delivery receipt
acceptanceTests.passCondition: Every attempt records timestamp, response fingerprint, correlation and final state without storing secrets.

acceptanceTests.name: Agency handoff
acceptanceTests.passCondition: The agency can operate the workflow using the runbook without direct AckWeave contact with its client.

agency: Own the client relationship and all client communication.
Confirm authorization for every environment, destination and test fixture.
Provide the agreed event contract and accept the final handoff.
ackweave: Implement one bounded delivery path and its reliability controls.
Test only synthetic or explicitly authorized inputs and targets.
Return the implementation, evidence records and operator runbook to the agency.

commercial.name: Delivery Reliability Sprint
commercial.includes: One workflow, one destination adapter, replay protection, acceptance tests and handoff evidence.
commercial.expansionBoundary: Additional workflows, destinations, production operation and support are separately scoped after acceptance.

limitations: This pack is a delivery specification and synthetic demonstration, not proof that the named workflow has been implemented.
No client endpoint, credential or production system is accessed until the agency supplies explicit authorization.
White-label delivery does not transfer ownership of AckWeave's reusable engine; the agency receives the agreed workflow implementation and handoff materials.
